sentiment.reason_en: The VIX at 19.03 (+14.09%) places the market in risk-off mode (VIX>18). The S&P 500 sits at 7,663.43 with -1.21% and the DXY at 101.69 (+0.08%) reflects a strong dollar, a classic pressure on risk assets. Brent rises to $114.17 (+0.88%) while gold falls to $4,035.80 (-0.61%), confirming a bearish tilt for equities and commodities. The TLT rise (+1.87%) points to higher rates, reinforcing a financial repression scenario.
